# GitHub Copilot Instructions

When performing a code review, respond in Japanese.

## Review Language

- Pull request review comments must be written in Japanese.
- Explanations, suggestions, and summaries must be written in Japanese.
- Do not use English for review prose unless there is a technical reason.
- Keep technical identifiers such as API names, URLs, library names, function names, file paths, and commands unchanged when translating them would reduce accuracy.
